newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-JAYASURIYA MISSES LARA'S RECORD BY 35 RUNS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-JAYASURIYA MISSES LARA'S RECORD BY 35 RUNS.

text.p: Sri Lanka batsman Sanath Jayasuriya missed beating Brian Lara's record of highest individual runs in an innings when he was out for 340 on the final day of the first test against India in Colombo on Wedneday.

Jayasuriya, 326 not out overnight, was caught at silly point by Saurav Ganguly off the bowling of Rajesh Chauhan, 35 runs short of Lara's record 375 set for the West Indies against England in Antigua three years ago.
